senses.en: a prehistoric reptile, often large, known mainly from fossils
a person or thing considered outdated and resistant to change

ex.en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
ex.zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。

ex.en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
ex.zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。

tip: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。

senses.en: Make someone interested in or drawn towards something
Pull something closer through a physical force

ex.en: The bright flowers attract butterflies to our small balcony.
ex.zh: 鲜艳的花朵把蝴蝶吸引到我们的小阳台上。

ex.en: Cities that invest in reliable public transport are more likely to attract businesses and skilled workers.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠公共交通的城市更有可能吸引企业和技术人才。

tip: attract是及物动词，直接接人或事物作宾语。

senses.en: to spend time with other people in a friendly way
to teach someone how to behave in society

ex.en: Teenagers need chances to socialise with friends outside school.
ex.zh: 青少年需要在校外与朋友交往的机会。

ex.en: The new community centre gives older people a safe place to socialise and learn new skills.
ex.zh: 新的社区中心为老年人提供了一个安全的地方来社交和学习新技能。

tip: 英式拼写 socialise，美式 socialize；常与 with 连用。

senses.en: to change something completely, often for the better
to change the form of something

ex.en: A good teacher can transform a shy student into a confident speaker.
ex.zh: 好老师能把害羞的学生变成自信的演讲者。

ex.en: Solar panels have transformed the way this small town gets its power.
ex.zh: 太阳能板改变了这个小镇获取电力的方式。

tip: 常用 transform A into B；比 change 语气强，强调彻底改变。

senses.en: to interrupt, annoy, or worry someone
to make the effort to do something
trouble or effort that causes inconvenience

ex.en: Please do not bother your sister while she studies.
ex.zh: 你姐姐学习时，请不要打扰她。

ex.en: Constant notifications can bother students during lessons and reduce their ability to concentrate on complex tasks.
ex.zh: 持续不断的通知会在课堂上干扰学生，降低他们专注于复杂任务的能力。

col: bother someone with something｜拿某事打扰某人
bother to do something｜费心做某事
a lot of bother｜很多麻烦
tip: bother to do常用于否定或疑问，表示费心做。

senses.en: to go down and rest on your knees

ex.en: She had to kneel down to tie her little brother's shoes.
ex.zh: 她不得不跪下来给弟弟系鞋带。

ex.en: Visitors to the ancient temple often kneel in front of the stone statue to show respect.
ex.zh: 参观这座古庙的游客常常在石像前跪下以示敬意。

col: kneel on the floor｜跪在地上
tip: 过去式 knelt 或 kneeled；注意双写 l 加 ing：kneeling。

senses.en: A fight between armed forces.
A difficult struggle to achieve something or overcome a problem.
To struggle hard against someone or something.

ex.en: The museum displays armour from a famous battle.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了某场著名战役中使用的盔甲。

ex.en: The battle against air pollution requires coordinated action from governments, businesses, and individuals across urban areas.
ex.zh: 对抗空气污染需要城市各地的政府、企业和个人协调行动。

col: battle against pollution｜与污染作斗争
battle for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip: battle可指具体战斗，也常比喻与疾病或困难抗争。

senses.en: Not needed or serving no useful purpose.

ex.en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
ex.zh: 带一件薄外套吧，但厚靴子就没必要了。

ex.en: Clear instructions can prevent unnecessary delays and help public services operate more efficiently.
ex.zh: 清晰的指引可以避免不必要的延误，帮助公共服务更高效地运作。

col: avoid unnecessary delays｜避免不必要的延误
tip: 表示“没必要做”可用 it is unnecessary to do。

senses.en: A game or problem that tests your thinking skills.
Something that is difficult to understand or explain.
To make someone feel confused because something is difficult to understand.

ex.en: We finished the puzzle together on the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 我们在厨房桌上一起完成了拼图。

ex.en: The relationship between income and personal happiness remains a puzzle that researchers approach from several different perspectives.
ex.zh: 收入与个人幸福感之间的关系仍是一个谜，研究人员正从多个不同角度探索它。

tip: puzzled形容人感到困惑；puzzling形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: liking to talk a lot

ex.en: Our new classmate is very talkative and makes friends easily.
ex.zh: 我们的新同学很健谈，很容易交朋友。

ex.en: Although she is talkative in class, she always listens carefully when the teacher explains difficult points.
ex.zh: 尽管她在课堂上很健谈，但当老师讲解难点时，她总是认真听讲。

tip: talkative 常修饰人，含“爱说话”之意，有时略带贬义。

senses.en: To make something less enjoyable, useful, or attractive.
To give someone excessive attention or everything they want.
To become, or make food become, unfit to eat.

ex.en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
ex.zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。

ex.en: Poorly planned construction can spoil natural landscapes and reduce their appeal to both residents and tourists.
ex.zh: 规划不当的建设会破坏自然景观，降低其对居民和游客的吸引力。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

senses.en: the area next to a bed
happening or kept beside a bed

ex.en: She put a glass of water on the bedside table.
ex.zh: 她在床头柜上放了一杯水。

ex.en: The nurse stayed at the patient's bedside all night and checked his temperature twice.
ex.zh: 护士整夜守在病人床边，给他量了两次体温。

col: bedside manner｜医生对病人的态度
tip: 常用搭配 at one's bedside；bedside manner 指医生的态度，不是床的样式。

senses.en: To lose blood from a wound or inside the body.

ex.en: My finger started to bleed after a small paper cut.
ex.zh: 我的手指被纸轻轻划了一下，开始流血了。

ex.en: First aid courses teach people how to respond safely when minor injuries cause someone to bleed.
ex.zh: 急救课程教人们在轻伤导致出血时如何安全应对。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bled；blood是名词“血”。

senses.en: the large glass window at the front of a car or other vehicle

ex.en: The driver cleaned the windshield before starting the car.
ex.zh: 司机在发动汽车前清洁了挡风玻璃。

ex.en: A stone flew up and cracked the windshield, so the car had to be taken to a repair shop.
ex.zh: 一块石头飞起来砸裂了挡风玻璃，所以汽车不得不送去修理店。

tip: 美式用windshield，英式用windscreen。

senses.en: An organised group of people who sing together.

ex.en: My sister sings in the choir every Sunday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周日都在唱诗班唱歌。

ex.en: Joining a community choir can reduce loneliness and strengthen social connections among older adults.
ex.zh: 加入社区合唱团可以减轻老年人的孤独感，并加强他们的社会联系。

tip: 发音近似quire，开头不是常见的/ch/音。

senses.en: An important or basic part of something.
A substance that cannot be chemically divided into simpler substances.
Strong wind, rain, or other difficult weather conditions.

ex.en: Fresh herbs are a key element of this soup.
ex.zh: 新鲜香草是这道汤的关键配料。

ex.en: Public trust is an essential element of any successful policy aimed at improving community health.
ex.zh: 公众信任是任何旨在改善社区健康的政策取得成功的必要因素。

col: exposure to the elements｜暴露于风雨之中
tip: 表示风雨等自然力量时，通常用the elements。

senses.en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
ex.zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。

ex.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
ex.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

col: a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

senses.en: Travel across water in a boat or ship.
A large sheet of material that catches wind to move boats.

ex.en: We sailed across the lake on a sunny afternoon.
ex.zh: 一个晴朗的下午，我们乘船驶过湖面。

ex.en: Ships that sail through sensitive marine habitats should follow strict rules to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 驶经敏感海洋栖息地的船只应遵守严格规定，以保护野生动物。

col: sail across the ocean｜航行穿越大洋
tip: 作动词不限于帆船，也可指轮船航行。

senses.en: December 26, a public holiday in Britain and several other countries.

ex.en: We usually eat leftover turkey together on Boxing Day.
ex.zh: 我们通常在节礼日一起吃剩下的火鸡肉。

ex.en: Boxing Day sales can boost retail revenue, but they also raise concerns about unnecessary consumption.
ex.zh: 节礼日促销能增加零售收入，但也引发了对不必要消费的担忧。

col: a Boxing Day walk｜节礼日散步
tip: 固定指12月26日；首字母大写，不加连字符。
note: 已将非标准拼写boxing-day改为Boxing Day。

senses.en: the crime of deliberately and unlawfully killing someone
to deliberately and unlawfully kill someone

ex.en: We watched a film about a detective investigating a murder.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部讲述侦探调查谋杀案的电影。

ex.en: Accurate forensic evidence plays a crucial role in solving murder cases and preventing wrongful convictions.
ex.zh: 准确的法医证据对侦破谋杀案和防止误判起着关键作用。

col: be charged with murder｜被控谋杀
tip: murder强调非法且故意杀人；kill含义更广。

senses.en: An area defined by its features or official boundaries.

ex.en: We found a small bakery in the old market district.
ex.zh: 我们在老市场区找到了一家小面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in suburban districts can reduce car dependence and widen access to employment.
ex.zh: 改善郊区的公共交通可以减少对汽车的依赖，并增加就业机会。

tip: 可指行政划分，也可指具有特定功能的城区。

senses.en: To be unlike something else in one or more ways.
To have a different opinion from another person.

ex.en: These jackets differ in price, but both look great.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克价格不同，但都很好看。

ex.en: Educational priorities differ between countries because economic conditions and cultural expectations shape national policies.
ex.zh: 各国的教育重点有所不同，因为经济条件和文化期待会影响国家政策。

col: differ with someone｜与某人意见不同
tip: from引出比较对象，in引出差异方面。

senses.en: affecting or involving most people, things, or situations
describing main points rather than particular details
an officer with a very high rank in the army

ex.en: There was general agreement that the kitchen needed repainting.
ex.zh: 大家普遍同意厨房需要重新刷漆。

ex.en: Although the general standard of education has improved, significant differences remain between urban and rural schools.
ex.zh: 尽管教育总体水平已有提高，城乡学校之间仍存在显著差异。

tip: in general意为“一般来说”，常用于概括。

senses.en: a thick cloud near the ground that limits visibility
to become or make a surface covered with fine droplets

ex.en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
ex.zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。

ex.en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
ex.zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。

tip: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

senses.en: To consider someone or something responsible for a problem.
Responsibility for something bad that has happened.

ex.en: Don't blame me for the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 别把厨房椅子坏了的事怪到我头上。

ex.en: It is unfair to blame individuals alone for environmental problems caused partly by industrial activity.
ex.zh: 环境问题部分由工业活动造成，仅归咎于个人并不公平。

col: blame someone for something｜因某事责怪某人
blame something on someone｜把某事归咎于某人
tip: 人作宾语用blame sb for；事作宾语用blame sth on。

senses.en: Used when expecting others to agree that something is true
Certainly, or in a way that will achieve a result

ex.en: Surely you can spare five minutes to help?
ex.zh: 你总能抽出五分钟来帮忙吧？

ex.en: Surely governments should prioritise clean drinking water before investing public money in expensive sports facilities.
ex.zh: 政府在投入公共资金建设昂贵的体育设施之前，总该优先保障清洁饮用水吧。

col: slowly but surely｜缓慢而稳步地
will surely lead to｜必将导致
tip: 是副词；句首常表示期待对方赞同。

senses.en: Relating to education after primary school and before higher education.
Less important than something else.

ex.en: My sister starts secondary school after the summer holidays.
ex.zh: 暑假过后，我妹妹就要上中学了。

ex.en: Access to quality secondary education can improve employment prospects for young people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得优质中等教育的机会可以改善农村年轻人的就业前景。

tip: 表示“次于”用secondary to，不用secondary than。

senses.en: Directly below something, often covered or hidden by it.
In a lower position, often beneath a covering.

ex.en: Your slippers are underneath the chair by the bed.
ex.zh: 你的拖鞋在床边那把椅子下面。

ex.en: Insulation installed underneath floors can reduce heat loss and improve energy efficiency in older homes.
ex.zh: 在地板下面铺设保温材料，可以减少老房屋的热量流失并提高能源效率。

tip: 后接名词时是介词；单独使用时是副词。

senses.en: to make a tape or video go backwards
to wind something around again

ex.en: Please rewind the tape before you return it to the library.
ex.zh: 请把磁带倒回去再还给图书馆。

ex.en: You cannot rewind time, so it is wise to think carefully before making big decisions.
ex.zh: 你无法让时间倒流，所以在做重大决定前仔细思考是明智的。

col: rewind to the beginning｜倒回开头
tip: rewind 的过去式和过去分词是 rewound /riːˈwaʊnd/。

senses.en: allowed something; the past tense and past participle of permit

ex.en: We were permitted to feed the goats at noon.
ex.zh: 我们获准在中午给山羊喂食。

ex.en: Students should be permitted to use digital tools when these genuinely support learning rather than distract from it.
ex.zh: 当数字工具确实有助于学习而非分散注意力时，应允许学生使用。

col: be permitted to do something｜获准做某事
tip: permit过去式双写t；被动式后接to do。

senses.en: Covered with small round marks or patches.

ex.en: A spotted dog was sleeping beside the garden gate.
ex.zh: 一只带斑点的狗正睡在花园门旁。

ex.en: Some spotted animals blend into their surroundings, making them harder for predators to detect.
ex.zh: 一些有斑点的动物能融入周围环境，使捕食者更难发现它们。

tip: 也可作spot的过去式或过去分词，意为发现。

senses.en: a word that ends with the same sound as another
to end with the same sound as another word

ex.en: “Cat” is a rhyme for “hat”.
ex.zh: “cat”是“hat”的押韵词。

ex.en: Many nursery rhymes help children remember words because they rhyme and have a strong beat.
ex.zh: 许多童谣帮助孩子记住单词，因为它们押韵且节奏感强。

tip: 注意拼写：rhyme 以 rh 开头，但读音与 rime 相同。

senses.en: A structure built to honour a person or important event.
An old structure valued for its historical importance.

ex.en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
ex.zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。

ex.en: Protecting ancient monuments can strengthen cultural identity while attracting visitors and supporting employment in local communities.
ex.zh: 保护古迹既能增强文化认同，又能吸引游客，为当地社区创造就业机会。

tip: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

senses.en: To cook food using direct heat from above or below.
A cooking device that exposes food to direct heat.
To question someone intensely, often for a long time.

ex.en: We grilled some peppers and ate them with rice.
ex.zh: 我们烤了些甜椒，配米饭吃。

ex.en: Grilling vegetables with little oil can be a practical way to prepare healthier meals at home.
ex.zh: 用少量油烤蔬菜，是在家制作更健康餐食的一种实用方法。

col: under the grill｜在烤架热源下
grill someone about something｜就某事盘问某人
tip: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。

senses.en: to damage something so badly that it loses its value
the remains of a building that has been badly damaged
the complete loss of money, success, or good condition

ex.en: Heavy rain ruined the picnic we had planned.
ex.zh: 大雨毁掉了我们计划好的野餐。

ex.en: Uncontrolled tourism can ruin fragile natural habitats unless visitor numbers and construction activities are carefully managed.
ex.zh: 除非严格管理游客数量和建设活动，否则无序旅游可能毁掉脆弱的自然栖息地。

col: ruin someone's plans｜打乱某人的计划
tip: 表示建筑遗迹常用复数ruins，如ancient ruins。

senses.en: A session where people learn by discussing and practising together.
A room or building where things are made or repaired.

ex.en: I made a clay bowl at a pottery workshop.
ex.zh: 我在陶艺工作坊做了一个陶碗。

ex.en: Schools should offer practical workshops that help students develop communication skills through collaborative activities.
ex.zh: 学校应开设实践工作坊，帮助学生通过合作活动培养沟通能力。

tip: 表示学习活动时，通常强调参与和实践，而非只听讲。

senses.en: A friend or someone you share an activity with
An animal's partner for breeding
To breed, or bring animals together to breed

ex.en: I'm meeting a mate for lunch near the station.
ex.zh: 我要在车站附近和一个朋友吃午饭。

ex.en: Some bird species stay with the same mate for years, sharing responsibility for raising their young.
ex.zh: 某些鸟类会与同一配偶相伴多年，共同承担养育幼鸟的责任。

tip: 表示朋友时属英式非正式用语，正式写作宜用friend。

senses.en: Food and household supplies bought at a shop; usually plural.
A shop selling food and basic household supplies.

ex.en: I carried two bags of groceries into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我把两袋食品杂货提进了厨房。

ex.en: Rising grocery prices place considerable pressure on households that already spend most of their income on essentials.
ex.zh: 食品杂货价格上涨给那些已将大部分收入用于必需品的家庭带来了巨大压力。

tip: 食品杂货用复数groceries；作定语用grocery。

senses.en: To make someone smile or laugh.
To keep someone pleasantly occupied.

ex.en: His silly dance amused everyone waiting in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他滑稽的舞蹈逗乐了在厨房等候的每个人。

ex.en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
ex.zh: 博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。

col: keep someone amused｜让某人不无聊
tip: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。

senses.en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities.
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
ex.zh: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。

ex.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

col: a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

senses.en: instructions explaining how to prepare and cook a dish

senses.zh: 促成某结果的方法或因素
senses.en: a method or situation likely to produce a particular result

ex.en: This soup recipe needs only a few simple ingredients.
ex.zh: 这个汤的食谱只需要几种简单的食材。

ex.en: Investment in teacher training and accessible learning materials provides a recipe for educational success.
ex.zh: 投资教师培训并提供易于获取的学习材料，是推动教育成功的有效方法。

col: follow a recipe｜按照食谱做菜
a recipe for success｜成功之道
a recipe for disaster｜招致灾难的做法
tip: recipe指做菜方法；menu是菜单，prescription是处方。

senses.en: the need for food or suffering caused by its lack
a strong desire for something
to want something very strongly

ex.en: A bowl of warm soup quickly satisfied my hunger.
ex.zh: 一碗热汤很快就让我不饿了。

ex.en: Reducing global hunger requires reliable food supplies as well as better access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 减少全球饥饿既需要可靠的食物供应，也需要更多受教育和就业的机会。

tip: 名词通常不可数；渴望某物用hunger for。

senses.en: a body temperature higher than normal, usually caused by illness
intense excitement shared by a person or group

ex.en: He stayed in bed because he had a fever.
ex.zh: 他因为发烧而卧床休息。

ex.en: A persistent fever may indicate an infection and should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.
ex.zh: 持续发热可能意味着感染，应由合格的医疗专业人员进行评估。

tip: 表示发烧常说have a fever，也可说have a temperature。

senses.en: a small cupboard for keeping personal belongings secure

ex.en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
ex.zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。

ex.en: Providing each student with a locker can reduce the weight of bags carried around school.
ex.zh: 为每位学生配备储物柜，可以减轻他们在校园内携带的书包重量。

tip: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

senses.en: half of a circle
a group of people or things arranged in a half circle

ex.en: The children sat in a semicircle around the storyteller.
ex.zh: 孩子们围着讲故事的人坐成半圆形。

ex.en: The new library has a large semicircle window that lets in plenty of morning light.
ex.zh: 新图书馆有一扇很大的半圆形窗户，让大量晨光透进来。

col: semicircle of chairs｜半圆形的椅子
tip: 前缀 semi- 意为“一半”，如 semifinal 半决赛。

senses.en: Existing or happening in all parts of the world.
In or to all parts of the world.

ex.en: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
ex.zh: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。

ex.en: Worldwide cooperation is essential for reducing carbon emissions and protecting communities from the effects of climate change.
ex.zh: 全球合作对于减少碳排放、保护社区免受气候变化影响至关重要。

tip: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：sell worldwide。

senses.en: during the recent period up to the present

ex.en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
ex.zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？

ex.en: Lately, researchers have paid greater attention to the relationship between access to green spaces and mental health.
ex.zh: 近来，研究人员更加关注绿地可及性与心理健康之间的关系。

tip: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。

senses.en: A small object that holds things together or in place.
A short section of a film or audio recording.
To fasten with a clip, or cut something shorter.

ex.en: She used a clip to hold her hair back.
ex.zh: 她用夹子把头发固定在后面。

ex.en: Teachers can use a short video clip to introduce complex scientific concepts before a classroom discussion.
ex.zh: 教师可以在课堂讨论前，用一段短视频引入复杂的科学概念。

col: clip something onto｜把某物夹在……上
tip: 夹在某物上用clip onto；短视频片段也叫clip。

senses.en: more important than anything else
relating to the first stage of formal schooling
original or direct, rather than derived from something else

ex.en: Our primary concern is keeping the children safe.
ex.zh: 我们最关心的是确保孩子们安全。

ex.en: Investment in primary education can reduce inequality by giving children a stronger foundation for future learning.
ex.zh: 投资初等教育可以为儿童今后的学习打下更牢固的基础，从而减少不平等。

tip: primary school指小学；primarily是副词。

senses.en: not telling the truth or cheating

ex.en: It is dishonest to copy someone else's homework.
ex.zh: 抄袭别人的作业是不诚实的。

ex.en: The company was accused of dishonest advertising, which misled many customers.
ex.zh: 该公司被指控做虚假广告，误导了许多顾客。

col: be dishonest with sb｜对某人不诚实
tip: 反义词是 honest，名词是 dishonesty。

senses.en: Easy to notice or understand.

ex.en: The muddy footprints made the dog's hiding place obvious.
ex.zh: 泥脚印让狗的藏身处一目了然。

ex.en: The environmental benefits of cycling are obvious, but safer routes are needed to encourage more people to cycle.
ex.zh: 骑自行车的环境效益显而易见，但还需更安全的路线来鼓励更多人骑行。

col: for obvious reasons｜出于显而易见的原因
obvious to everyone｜人人都看得出来
tip: 常用It is obvious that…表示“显然……”。

senses.en: a game in which players mark numbers on a card
used to show you have succeeded or suddenly understood

ex.en: My grandmother plays bingo with her friends every Friday evening.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每周五晚上都和朋友玩宾果游戏。

ex.en: Bingo! I finally found the mistake in my maths homework after checking twice.
ex.zh: 太棒了！我检查了两遍，终于找到了数学作业里的错误。

tip: 作感叹词表示“成功了、找到了”，口语常用，只用于轻松场合。

senses.en: A long-handled tool for washing floors
To clean a surface or remove liquid with absorbent material

ex.en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 我用拖把擦洗了沾满泥的厨房地板。

ex.en: Staff should mop shared floors regularly to maintain hygiene in schools and other public buildings.
ex.zh: 工作人员应定期拖洗公共区域的地面，以保持学校及其他公共建筑的卫生。

col: mop up a spill｜擦净洒出的液体
a mop and bucket｜拖把和水桶
tip: 动词过去式mopped，进行式mopping，均双写p。

senses.en: Someone who temporarily looks after children while their parents are away

ex.en: The baby-sitter read our daughter a story before bed.
ex.zh: 临时保姆在睡前给我们女儿读了一个故事。

ex.en: Hiring a reliable baby-sitter can help parents balance occasional evening work with their family responsibilities.
ex.zh: 雇用可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间工作和家庭责任。

col: experienced baby-sitter｜有经验的临时保姆
tip: 现代更常写babysitter；通常指临时照看孩子的人。

senses.en: To officially accept or allow something.
To think that someone or something is good or acceptable.

ex.en: My manager approved my request for a day off.
ex.zh: 经理批准了我请一天假的申请。

ex.en: Local authorities should approve housing developments only when adequate transport and essential services are available.
ex.zh: 地方政府应仅在交通和基本服务充足的情况下批准住宅开发项目。

tip: 批准某事用approve；赞成某事用approve of。

senses.en: a talk that explains something to an audience
the way something is arranged, shown, or expressed
the formal act of giving something to someone

ex.en: I practised my presentation in front of my sister.
ex.zh: 我在姐姐面前练习了一遍报告。

ex.en: Giving a group presentation allows students to develop communication skills and learn how to divide responsibilities.
ex.zh: 进行小组报告能让学生培养沟通能力，并学习如何分工。

tip: 作报告用give a presentation；注意present作动词的重音。

senses.en: the greatest amount or level that is allowed or possible
to control how much something can increase or happen

ex.en: There is a limit to what this bag can hold.
ex.zh: 这个包能装的东西是有限的。

ex.en: Governments should limit industrial emissions while providing financial support for businesses adopting cleaner production methods.
ex.zh: 政府应限制工业排放，同时为采用更清洁生产方式的企业提供资金支持。

col: limit something to｜将某事物限制在
tip: limit A to B意为将A限制在B范围内。

senses.en: relating to living things or the study of life
related by birth, not by adoption

ex.en: The park protects many kinds of plants and their biological needs.
ex.zh: 这个公园保护许多种植物及其生物需求。

ex.en: Scientists are studying the biological reasons why some people sleep less than others.
ex.zh: 科学家正在研究为什么有些人比其他人睡得少，其生物学原因是什么。

tip: 注意 biological parents 意为“亲生父母”，与 adoptive parents 相对。

senses.en: Having a pattern of long, narrow bands.

ex.en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件条纹衬衫和深蓝色牛仔裤。

ex.en: The striped coats of certain animals may help them avoid detection in their natural habitats.
ex.zh: 某些动物带条纹的皮毛可能有助于它们在自然栖息地中避免被发现。

tip: striped意为有条纹的；strip的过去式是stripped。

senses.en: in a way that shows you are angry

ex.en: He angrily pushed the broken chair away and left the room.
ex.zh: 他生气地把坏椅子推开，离开了房间。

ex.en: When the teacher saw the wasted food, she spoke angrily to the whole class about it.
ex.zh: 老师看到浪费的食物后，愤怒地对全班讲了这件事。

tip: 副词修饰动词，angry 是形容词；注意 angry at sb / angry about sth。

senses.en: list of topics or a number showing changes
to make an index for a book or adjust automatically

ex.en: Check the index at the back to find the topic quickly.
ex.zh: 查看后面的索引来快速找到话题。

ex.en: The consumer price index helps the government measure inflation and make economic decisions.
ex.zh: 消费者价格指数帮助政府衡量通货膨胀并做出经济决策。

tip: 注意复数形式常为 indexes；作动词时指“为…编索引”或“按指数调整”。

senses.en: A hard rectangular block used for building walls and houses.

ex.en: One loose brick fell out of the garden wall.
ex.zh: 花园围墙上掉下了一块松动的砖。

ex.en: Reusing brick from demolished buildings can reduce construction waste and preserve the character of older neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 重复利用拆除建筑中的砖可以减少建筑垃圾，并保留老街区的特色。

tip: 单块砖可数；作建筑材料统称时可不可数。

senses.en: Someone whose job is to design buildings
Someone who plans and develops an important change or project

ex.en: The architect showed us a model of our future home.
ex.zh: 建筑师给我们看了未来新家的模型。

ex.en: Architects can reduce energy consumption by designing buildings that make better use of natural light.
ex.zh: 建筑师可以通过设计更充分利用自然光的建筑来降低能耗。

col: chief architect｜首席建筑师；主要设计者
the architect of reform｜改革的设计者
tip: architect指人，architecture指建筑学或建筑风格。

senses.en: An object kept to remember a place, person, or event.

ex.en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
ex.zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。

ex.en: Buying a locally made souvenir can support traditional crafts and provide income for communities that depend on tourism.
ex.zh: 购买当地制作的纪念品可以支持传统工艺，并为依靠旅游业的社区带来收入。

tip: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

senses.en: either side of the face below the eyes
rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect

ex.en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
ex.zh: 在外面，一滴冰凉的雨水落在了我的脸颊上。

ex.en: Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.
ex.zh: 在极寒环境中工作时，防护服应遮住包括脸颊在内的裸露部位。

col: a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
have the cheek to｜竟厚着脸皮做
tip: 脸颊义可数；无礼义通常不可数，多用于英式口语。

senses.en: A strong desire to achieve a particular goal.
Determination to become successful, powerful, or highly skilled.

ex.en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
ex.zh: 她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。

ex.en: Schools should nurture students' ambition while helping them set realistic goals and develop practical skills.
ex.zh: 学校应培养学生的进取心，同时帮助他们设定切实可行的目标并发展实用技能。

col: ambition to succeed｜追求成功的雄心
tip: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

senses.en: using highly developed technology or methods
requiring knowledge or skills beyond a basic level
having reached a late stage of development or progress

ex.en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
ex.zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。

ex.en: Advanced medical technology can improve patient outcomes, but its high cost may increase inequalities in healthcare access.
ex.zh: 先进的医疗技术可以改善治疗效果，但其高昂成本可能加剧医疗服务获取方面的不平等。

col: at an advanced stage｜处于后期阶段
tip: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

senses.en: A small device worn in or over an ear for listening

ex.en: One earphone fell out while I was jogging.
ex.zh: 我慢跑时，一只耳机掉了出来。

ex.en: Students using earphones in shared study spaces can listen to educational recordings without disturbing others.
ex.zh: 学生在公共自习空间使用耳机，可以收听教学录音而不打扰他人。

col: a pair of earphones｜一副耳机
tip: 通常用复数earphones；一副耳机用a pair of。

senses.en: The official who leads or represents a city or town

ex.en: The mayor opened our new swimming pool yesterday.
ex.zh: 市长昨天为我们的新游泳馆主持了启用仪式。

ex.en: The newly elected mayor has promised to improve public transport and create more affordable housing for residents.
ex.zh: 新当选的市长承诺改善公共交通，并为居民提供更多可负担住房。

col: the mayor of a city｜一座城市的市长
tip: mayor是市长，别与major（主要的）混淆。

senses.en: A substance that can seriously harm or kill living things.
Harm living things or contaminate something with a toxic substance.
Make a relationship or situation unpleasant or harmful.

ex.en: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
ex.zh: 有些园艺植物含有毒素，因此要让宠物远离。

ex.en: Toxic waste from poorly regulated factories can poison rivers, threatening wildlife and the health of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 监管不力的工厂排出的有毒废物可能污染河流，威胁野生动物和附近居民的健康。

col: poison the water supply｜污染供水
tip: poison 是名词或动词；“有毒的”用 poisonous。

senses.en: Symbols or instructions representing information, including instructions for computers
A set of rules governing behaviour or practice
Write computer instructions or convert information into a coded form

ex.en: I forgot the code for my bicycle lock again.
ex.zh: 我又忘了自行车锁的密码。

ex.en: Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.
ex.zh: 教学生编写代码可以增强解决问题的能力，帮助他们适应不断变化的就业市场。

tip: 程序代码通常不可数；一组密码可说a code。

senses.en: a caterpillar that spins a cocoon of silk thread

ex.en: The children watched a silkworm spin its cocoon.
ex.zh: 孩子们看着一只蚕结茧。

ex.en: For centuries, raising silkworms has been an important source of income in some rural areas.
ex.zh: 几个世纪以来，养蚕一直是一些农村地区的重要收入来源。

tip: 可数名词，常用复数 silkworms；silk 是'蚕丝'。

senses.en: to move smoothly across a surface without lifting
a single image or page shown during a presentation
a sloping structure that children slide down

ex.en: She slid the plate across the table towards me.
ex.zh: 她把盘子沿着桌面推滑到我面前。

ex.en: Teachers can use a carefully designed slide to explain complex scientific processes more clearly.
ex.zh: 教师可以用精心设计的幻灯片更清楚地解释复杂的科学过程。

tip: 动词过去式和过去分词均为slid。

senses.en: being the greatest amount or level possible or allowed
the greatest amount or level possible or allowed

ex.en: This lift has a maximum capacity of eight people.
ex.zh: 这部电梯最多可容纳八人。

ex.en: Governments should set maximum limits on industrial emissions to protect public health and improve air quality.
ex.zh: 政府应对工业排放设定上限，以保护公众健康并改善空气质量。

tip: a maximum of表示“最多”；反义词是minimum。

senses.en: a reduction in the money, time, or resources used
money kept rather than spent, usually for future needs

ex.en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
ex.zh: 买月票让我省下了一笔实用的开支。

ex.en: Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.
ex.zh: 从长远来看，投资高效供暖系统能显著降低家庭能耗。

tip: 表示积蓄通常用复数savings；节省可用单数。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition
someone who strongly supports a cause or group
to actively support or defend a cause or person

ex.en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
ex.zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。

ex.en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
ex.zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。

col: a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者
champion a cause｜支持一项事业
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

senses.en: A small electric light carried in the hand.
A stick with burning material at one end, providing light.

ex.en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
ex.zh: 我用手电筒寻找丢失的钥匙。

ex.en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
ex.zh: 徒步者在日落后探索偏远地区时，应携带手电筒和备用电池。

col: switch on a torch｜打开手电筒
a torch beam｜手电筒的光束
tip: 手电筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。

senses.en: the feeling of finding something funny; enjoyment
a place or machine for fun, such as a park

ex.en: The kids screamed with amusement on the spinning ride.
ex.zh: 孩子们在旋转游乐设施上又笑又叫。

ex.en: Some people worry that too much amusement from short videos takes time away from reading.
ex.zh: 一些人担心短视频带来的过多娱乐会挤占阅读时间。

col: to one's amusement｜令某人好笑的是
tip: amused 修饰人（感到好笑的），amusing 修饰物（令人发笑的）。

senses.en: A narrow break in a surface or solid object
Break or cause something to break without completely separating
A sudden sharp sound, like something breaking

ex.en: There's a thin crack across my favourite blue mug.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的蓝色杯子上有一道细细的裂纹。

ex.en: Engineers discovered a crack in the bridge during a routine inspection and recommended immediate repairs.
ex.zh: 工程师在例行检查中发现桥梁有一道裂缝，并建议立即维修。

col: a crack in the wall｜墙上的裂缝
a loud crack｜响亮的爆裂声
tip: crack常指裂而未碎；shatter强调碎成许多片。

senses.en: the act of giving money for something
an amount of money paid or due to be paid

ex.en: The shop accepts payment by card or cash.
ex.zh: 这家商店接受刷卡或现金付款。

ex.en: Digital payment systems can make everyday transactions more convenient, but they may exclude people without internet access.
ex.zh: 数字支付系统能让日常交易更便捷，但可能将无法上网的人排除在外。

tip: 支付行为通常不可数；一笔款项可用a payment。

senses.en: Feeling or showing happiness and a positive attitude.
Making a place or experience feel bright and pleasant.

ex.en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
ex.zh: 我们出门时，开朗的邻居向我们挥了挥手。

ex.en: A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.
ex.zh: 愉快的课堂氛围能鼓励年幼的学习者更积极地参与小组讨论。

tip: 既可形容人心情开朗，也可形容环境明快。

senses.en: a word showing relationships, such as location, direction, or time

ex.en: Our teacher used a toy rabbit to explain each preposition.
ex.zh: 老师用一只玩具兔来解释每个介词。

ex.en: Choosing the correct preposition helps language learners express relationships between ideas more precisely in academic writing.
ex.zh: 选择正确的介词有助于语言学习者在学术写作中更准确地表达观点之间的关系。

col: a preposition of place｜地点介词
a preposition of time｜时间介词
tip: 介词后通常接名词、代词或动名词。

senses.en: Feeling extremely afraid.

ex.en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚雷声震得窗户发抖时，我吓坏了。

ex.en: Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.
ex.zh: 极度害怕公开演讲的学生，可以通过在互相支持的小组中练习展示而受益。

col: terrified at the thought of｜一想到就惊恐
tip: 人感到害怕用terrified；事物吓人用terrifying。

senses.en: people or things arranged in a straight line
to move a boat through water using oars
a noisy argument or loud disturbance

ex.en: We found two empty seats in the front row.
ex.zh: 我们在前排找到了两个空座位。

ex.en: Planting a row of trees beside busy roads can help reduce noise and improve local air quality.
ex.zh: 在繁忙道路旁种植一排树木，有助于降低噪声并改善当地空气质量。

col: in a row｜排成一排；连续
tip: “排、划船”读/rəʊ/；“争吵”英美均读/raʊ/。

senses.en: Sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement beneath Earth's surface.

ex.en: The earthquake made the cups rattle on our kitchen shelf.
ex.zh: 地震使厨房架子上的杯子碰得咯咯作响。

ex.en: Strict building regulations can significantly reduce the risk of injury when an earthquake strikes a densely populated city.
ex.zh: 当地震袭击人口稠密的城市时，严格的建筑法规可以显著降低人员受伤的风险。

tip: 可数名词；表示发生地震可说an earthquake strikes。

senses.en: Money paid to the government to fund public services.
Require someone to pay money to the government.
Put heavy demands on someone's strength or abilities.

ex.en: The tax on my monthly salary has gone up.
ex.zh: 我每月工资要缴的税增加了。

ex.en: Governments can use tax revenue to improve public transport and make healthcare more accessible.
ex.zh: 政府可以利用税收改善公共交通，让医疗服务惠及更多人。

tip: tax可作名词或动词；taxing常指费力的、累人的。

senses.en: Protection from danger or bad weather.
A place that provides safety or protection.
To stay somewhere protected, or protect someone from harm.

ex.en: We found shelter under a bridge during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，我们躲到一座桥下避雨。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide temporary shelter for residents whose homes have been damaged by floods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应为房屋遭洪水损坏的居民提供临时住所。

tip: 表示庇护通常不可数；指具体避难所时可数。

senses.en: to a moderate degree, but not very
in a way that treats people equally and reasonably

ex.en: The walk home was fairly short and very pleasant.
ex.zh: 走路回家的路程还算短，一路也很惬意。

ex.en: Schools should distribute resources fairly so that students from disadvantaged backgrounds receive the support they need.
ex.zh: 学校应公平分配资源，让背景不利的学生获得所需的支持。

col: distribute resources fairly｜公平分配资源
tip: 表程度时弱于very；fairly good是还不错，并非极好。

senses.en: An ability to perceive through sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.
A feeling or awareness of something.
To become aware of something without being directly told.

ex.en: Dogs have a much stronger sense of smell than humans.
ex.zh: 狗的嗅觉比人类灵敏得多。

ex.en: Community gardens can strengthen residents' sense of belonging by creating opportunities for regular social interaction.
ex.zh: 社区花园可以创造日常社交机会，从而增强居民的归属感。

tip: make sense指讲得通；make sense of指理解。

senses.en: to or towards one side
a small path branching off a main road

ex.en: He stepped sideway to let the cart pass.
ex.zh: 他向旁边挪了一步，让那辆推车过去。

ex.en: The bike moved sideway to avoid a hole in the road, and the rider kept her balance.
ex.zh: 自行车侧向移动以躲开路上的坑，骑车人保持了平衡。

tip: 更常见拼写是 sideways；表示'侧向地'一般用 sideways。

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

ex.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
ex.zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。

ex.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
ex.zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

col: a roll of tape｜一卷胶带
tip: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

senses.en: A passage built underground or through a hill.
To dig a passage underground or through something.

ex.en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
ex.zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。

ex.en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
ex.zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。

tip: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

senses.en: A path intended for walking rather than driving.

ex.en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
ex.zh: 一条狭窄的小径从我们村通向湖边。

ex.en: Maintaining rural footpaths encourages outdoor recreation while helping visitors avoid damage to surrounding farmland.
ex.zh: 维护乡村步道既能鼓励户外休闲，也能帮助游客避免破坏周围的农田。

tip: 常指供步行的小径，不一定紧邻公路。

senses.en: an amount of money
the total obtained by adding amounts together
to state the main points, usually with up

ex.en: She saved a small sum for a new bicycle.
ex.zh: 她为买一辆新自行车攒了一小笔钱。

ex.en: Governments invest large sums in public transport to reduce congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 政府在公共交通上投入巨资，以缓解拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

col: a large sum of money｜一大笔钱
tip: sum up表示总结；一笔钱用a sum of money。

senses.en: decorative paper used to cover interior walls
an image displayed behind icons on a screen
to cover walls with decorative paper

ex.en: We chose pale green wallpaper for our small bedroom.
ex.zh: 我们为小卧室选了浅绿色墙纸。

ex.en: Choosing durable wallpaper can reduce the frequency of interior renovations and limit household material waste.
ex.zh: 选择耐用的墙纸可以减少室内翻新的频率，降低家庭材料浪费。

col: a roll of wallpaper｜一卷墙纸
tip: wallpaper通常不可数；一卷用a roll of wallpaper。

senses.en: To reach, or make something reach, more people or places
To open something out or cover a surface with something
The process of reaching a wider area or more people

ex.en: She spread a blanket under the tree for our picnic.
ex.zh: 她在树下铺了一条毯子，供我们野餐用。

ex.en: The rapid spread of false information online highlights the importance of teaching critical reading skills in schools.
ex.zh: 虚假信息在网上迅速传播，凸显了学校教授批判性阅读技能的重要性。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病的传播
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为spread。

senses.en: To take off your own clothes or someone else's clothes.

ex.en: I undressed behind the curtain and put on pyjamas.
ex.zh: 我在帘子后脱下衣服，换上睡衣。

ex.en: Healthcare staff should provide private spaces where patients can undress comfortably before a physical examination.
ex.zh: 医护人员应提供私密空间，让患者在体检前安心脱衣。

tip: undress可不接宾语；脱某件衣服用take off。

senses.en: the country where someone was born

ex.en: After many years abroad, she finally returned to her homeland.
ex.zh: 在国外多年后，她终于回到了祖国。

ex.en: Many students study overseas but plan to use their skills to help their homeland.
ex.zh: 许多学生在海外学习，但计划用他们的技能帮助祖国。

col: return to one's homeland｜回到祖国
tip: homeland 比 motherland 更中性，可指祖国或家乡，新闻中常见。

senses.en: a view or situation that you see
the place where an event happens
a short part of a play or film

ex.en: The children playing by the lake made a peaceful scene.
ex.zh: 孩子们在湖边玩耍，构成了一幅宁静的画面。

ex.en: The film's opening scene highlights the challenges faced by families living in crowded urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 影片的开场片段突出了居住在拥挤城市社区的家庭面临的挑战。

tip: scene可数；scenery指整体风景，不可数。

senses.en: the act of winning a game, contest or battle

ex.en: The team celebrated a great victory after the final match.
ex.zh: 决赛之后，球队庆祝了一场伟大的胜利。

ex.en: Her quiet victory over shyness came after months of practising speeches in front of friends.
ex.zh: 在朋友面前练习演讲数月后，她悄悄战胜了害羞。

tip: victory 多可数；win a victory 比 get a victory 更自然。
